evidence.title: Agent Session Manager Desktop README
evidence.locator: Why, Features, Sessions on a server, Install, Getting started
evidence.finding: Wails desktop app running Claude, Codex, Gemini, Aider, Amazon Q, OpenCode, custom commands or shells in tmux or psmux sessions that survive closing the app; attention inbox with one-click replies; desktop and ntfy notifications; project dashboard with git status and Claude and Codex usage; diff with hunk revert; tasks with due dates and dependencies; remote servers over SSH; export and import of sessions.

evidence.title: Desktop CHANGELOG 1.1.27
evidence.finding: 1.1.27 adds groundwork for phone access over Tailscale, which only reaches pairing in this release; earlier releases added per-session and per-tab git worktrees, including on servers.

evidence.title: session/worktree.go
evidence.finding: Optional per-session git worktree on its own branch in a sibling directory, so parallel agents edit different files.

evidence.title: git_sync.go
evidence.finding: Pushing and pulling from the branch badge, which counts unpushed and unpulled commits.

evidence.title: mobile/server.go
evidence.finding: Mobile server listens on this computer only; a phone reaches it through tailscale serve; devices pair and stay let in until revoked.

evidence.title: headless.go
evidence.finding: asmgr-desktop --serve serves the phone page without the desktop window, using the same backend.

evidence.title: remote/client.go
evidence.finding: Remote servers over SSH with ssh-agent, key or password; host fingerprints checked; sessions live in the server's tmux with a stateless helper asmgrd.

evidence.title: notifications.go
evidence.finding: Desktop notifications and ntfy topic pushes when an agent starts waiting.

evidence.title: passwords/passwords.go
evidence.finding: Passwords from the app's keyring-backed list, KeePassXC, Bitwarden or a custom tool are typed into a terminal without reaching the UI, logs or settings.

evidence.title: token_usage_api.go
evidence.finding: Tokens per conversation and model per period on this computer and known servers, beside account-wide limit rings.

evidence.title: project_tasks_api.go
evidence.finding: Per-project task list API used by the task views.

evidence.title: mcp/taskmaster.go
evidence.finding: Optional Task Master integration calls the task-master-ai MCP package for PRD parsing, task expansion and complexity scoring.

evidence.title: interrupted_work.go
evidence.finding: After a reboot every session reads as stopped; the app picks up where a restart left off by offering the interrupted sessions.

evidence.title: go.mod
evidence.finding: Desktop app built on Wails v2.14.0 with WebView2 on Windows.

evidence.title: Bounded search: pull requests and merges
evidence.locator: grep -rliE "gh pr|pull request" --include=*.go (non-test): git_unpushed.go comment only
evidence.finding: No pull request creation or merge; git actions are push, pull, diff, revert and checkpoints.

evidence.title: Bounded search: telemetry, containers, schedules, SSO
evidence.locator: grep -rliE "telemetry|analytics|sentry|posthog" --include=*.go (0 files); review of top-level Go files and remote/, mobile/, mcp/ packages for docker, cron, saml
evidence.finding: No telemetry, container runtime, user schedules, SSO or roles found.

evidence.title: Bounded search: agent coordination
evidence.locator: review of mcp/ (Task Master client only) and commands_api.go, background_commands.go
evidence.finding: No agent-to-agent messaging or delegation; the MCP code is a client for Task Master.

evidence.title: ASMGR recovery-tasks
evidence.locator: Task/TaskStatus fields; UpdateTask 544-650; RestoreTask; GetNextTask 917-977; project_tasks.go TransferTask; project_tasks_api.go; mcp/taskmaster.go
evidence.finding: Desktop local tasks have IDs, tags, descriptions/details, status, priority, subtasks and dependencies. GetNextTask recommends unresolved work whose blockers are done; UpdateTask does not gate status by dependencies. Status can reopen done work. No archive or epic kind or dedicated acceptance-criteria/revision field. File backups preserve snapshots. Edits/undo retain IDs; cross-list moves can change a colliding ID and drop dependencies. Task Master is a client integration, not a product-owned agent task server.

evidence.title: ASMGR recovery-notes
evidence.locator: NotePage and ReadNotePages; project_tasks_api.go SetProjectNotePages; session/storage.go; session/backup_thinning.go; session_portable_api.go
evidence.finding: Desktop project/session/tab notes are titled text pages, replaced through setters and persisted with session settings. No named author or freshness engine. Backups keep all last-hour versions, hourly through one day, daily through 14 days and weekly through 90 days, always newest, subject to ceiling. Session exports use JSON portable bundles, not remote runtime or a provider transcript export.

evidence.title: ASMGR recovery-runtime
evidence.locator: DialTimeout/CommandTimeout; token_usage_api.go constants and TokenUsageItem; interrupted_work.go; mobile/server.go route inventory; passwords/passwords.go
evidence.finding: Desktop remote SSH connects in 10 seconds and bounds commands at 60 seconds. Token scans start after two minutes, repeat each 30 minutes and bound remote batches at two minutes; per-model/subagent counters include cache tokens. Mobile routes provide pairing/me/logout only. Session recovery/duplicate warnings do not provide exactly-once command replay. Password managers use backend-only values and 15-minute vault auto-lock; SSH host keys are checked.

evidence.title: ASMGR recovery-git
evidence.locator: gitPushAtPath 359-417 and gitPullAtPath; git_checkpoints.go private refs; git_checkpoint_cleanup.go; inspected git/diff/task API inventory
evidence.finding: Push compares expected HEAD and destination before publishing; changed previews must be refreshed. Pull is fast-forward only. Private-ref checkpoint commits preserve file trees without changing HEAD/index and are restorable. These are local git controls, not PR merge/deployment authority or a test/spec gate. No task-owned artifact gallery or exact-commit review queue in the inspected API inventory.

evidence.title: ASMGR recovery-tui
evidence.locator: AgentType, lifecycle and tmux methods; session/project.go/storage.go/agent_session.go; ui handlers; README separate-stores notice
evidence.finding: The TUI stores projects, session groups, tabs, notes, resume IDs and agent settings separately from Desktop. It supplies tmux/psmux terminals, history search and diff viewing; the inspected TUI has no Desktop task store, worktree UI, SSH server manager, phone server or Task Master client.

evidence.title: Agent Session Manager desktop: what leaves the machine, and pinned telemetry source inspection
evidence.locator: README.md lines 374-377 (What leaves your machine); bounded search of the pinned Go backend and frontend/src for telemetry, analytics, PostHog, Segment, Sentry, Amplitude, Mixpanel, Bugsnag, Datadog, gtag and crash reporting, excluding go.sum, lockfiles and SVGs; outbound hosts in *.go reviewed
evidence.finding: The README says nothing leaves the machine unless asked: the app talks to GitHub for its own updates, to an ntfy server if mobile push is configured, and to npx for Task Master; there is no telemetry. The source search found no analytics or crash client; outbound hosts are GitHub, ntfy, Google speech for opt-in dictation, and documentation links.
